entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: ¶My desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: For kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of God and serious behaviour.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: This is good and pleasing in the eyes of God our Saviour;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: Whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For there is one God and one peacemaker between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: Who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: And of this I became a preacher and an Apostle (what I say is true, not false,) and a teacher of the Gentiles in the true faith.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: It is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: ¶And that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: But clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of God.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: In my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: And Adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: But if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.
